description: 道路台帳一覧_2 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 南風原町. 南風原町の道路台帳町道181号線～町道289号線のデータです。. Coverage: 南風原町. The portal files it under the publisher 南風原町. Its tags are 道路台帳. It offers 97 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-01-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
